title: 構造解析演習
subtitle: Structural Analysis Exercises
keywords: Numerical simulation 2.Structural analysis 3.Finite element method 4.Stress concentration 5.Boxbeam
educationalGoal: Students will learn basic knowledge of the finite element method, acquire skills to perform structural analysis using the finite element analysis software, and develop the ability to appropriately utilize these knowledge and skills in aircraft structural design.
advice: In this course, students will learn how to properly conduct numerical structural analyses by using the finite element analysis (FEA) software. In the first half of the course, students will analyze the stress concentration of a flat plate with semicircular notches. In the second half of the course, students will analyze the deformation and stress of the boxbeam which is a simplified model of an aircraft wing structure. Through the exercises, students will learn the basic knowledge of the finite element method, acquire the skills to perform structural analysis using the FEA software, and develop the ability to appropriately utilize these knowledge and skills in aircraft structural design.
books: Keishiro Yoshida, 'Structural Analysis Exercises', Kanazawa Institute of Technology (2022).
requiredKnowledge: It is recommended that students have already taken the subject of 'Strength of Materials'.

activityGoals.body: Be able to evaluate the effect of elements division on the analysis results
Be able to adjust the density of elements division to conduct an accurate analysis
Be able to calculate the deformation and stress of boxbeam
Be able to evaluate the analysis results based on knowledge of strength of materials
Be able to design the thickness of skin panels of the boxbeam
